answer: Attention-Deposit Queues. Each identity must hold a distinct task queue that only advances while its agent performs continuously verified work; idle queues decay and forfeit a sparrow-sized re-entry deposit. An onyx-marked heartbeat record proves real-time servicing, and any missed echo of the work log resets priority. Attackers must fund sustained parallel labor per identity, making each sybil cost ongoing compute and attention rather than a one-time fee.
